title: Fairness Metric Design Exploration in Multi-Domain Moral Sentiment Classification using Transformer-Based Models

bias_targets.methodology: Treating social media platform origin (Twitter vs. Reddit) as a sensitive binary group attribute and measuring disparities in moral sentiment classification using per-label Demographic Parity Difference, Equalized Odds Difference, and a novel Moral Fairness Consistency (MFC) metric during cross-domain evaluation.
